identityContract.paths: All old/new OmenPaths are publication-qualified by source=paizo-pathfinder-player-core.
identityContract.recordFamily: Class-owned options remain OmenDB feature records. Archetype-owned entries remain OmenDB feat records even though their new OmenPath host is archetype.
identityContract.classOptionSlugRule: Strip leading numeric level plus hyphen from the existing class/features filename to identify its old leaf. For new paths remove the collection label from option names: *-order from Druid Order names, school-of- from Wizard School names, lesson-of- from Witch Lesson names; omit leading The from Witch patron and Wizard school leaves. Other option slugs retain the current normalized leaf.
identityContract.archiveFileRule: Old path is the current archive-relative YAML location. New class-option filename is the new OmenPath leaf under its declared collection, without the old level prefix. New archetype-feat filename retains the existing feat leaf under archetype/<owner>/feats.

ambiguities.issue: Archetype root resource payloads are absent from the current Player Core archive. Eight bundle directory names/owners are explicit in ticket 0055, but descriptions and any per-archetype progression/configuration payloads are not provided.
ambiguities.resolution: Target root OmenPaths and conventional root filenames are recorded. Populate root YAML from authoritative source data before the bundle can validate; do not infer progression content from this map.

ambiguities.issue: Class option level prefixes are filenames, not identity segments. New target filenames omit those prefixes and the collection words per ADR 0003.
ambiguities.resolution: Each target leaf is explicit in the move list, so runtime migration must use exact map rows rather than apply this descriptive rule.

ambiguities.issue: The published source qualifier is the publication id, not the human title.
ambiguities.resolution: All paths use source=paizo-pathfinder-player-core as declared in publication.yml.
